title: The King of Glory

questions.question: The earth is the Lord's and the fullness thereof, the world and those who what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 24:1 (ESV): "The earth is the Lord's and the fullness thereof, the world and those who dwell therein,"

questions.question: For he has founded it upon the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 24:2 (ESV): "for he has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the rivers."

questions.question: Who shall ascend the hill of the Lord? And who shall stand in his holy what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 24:3 (ESV): "Who shall ascend the hill of the Lord? And who shall stand in his holy place?"

questions.question: He who has clean hands and a pure what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 24:4 (ESV): "He who has clean hands and a pure heart..."

questions.question: Who does not lift up his soul to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 24:4 (ESV): "...who does not lift up his soul to what is false and does not swear deceitfully."

questions.question: He will receive blessing from the Lord and righteousness from the God of his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 24:5 (ESV): "He will receive blessing from the Lord and righteousness from the God of his salvation."

questions.question: Such is the generation of those who seek him, who seek the face of the God of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 24:6 (ESV): "...who seek the face of the God of Jacob."

questions.question: Lift up your heads, O gates! And be lifted up, O ancient what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 24:7 (ESV): "Lift up your heads, O gates! And be lifted up, O ancient doors..."

questions.question: That the King of glory may come in. Who is this King of glory? The Lord, strong and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 24:8 (ESV): "Who is this King of glory? The Lord, strong and mighty, the Lord, mighty in battle!"

questions.question: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 24:10 (ESV): "Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, he is the King of glory!"

questions.question: And be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of glory may what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 24:7 (ESV): "...that the King of glory may come in."

questions.question: He has established it upon the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 24:2 (ESV): "...and established it upon the rivers."

questions.question: The phrase "Selah" occurs how many times in Psalm 24?
questions.explanation: At the end of verse 6 and verse 10.

questions.question: Who does not swear deceitfully?
options: He who has clean hands and a pure heart
questions.correctAnswer: He who has clean hands and a pure heart

key_verse_text: The earth is the Lord's and the fullness thereof, the world and those who dwell therein,
